## Round 140 (2026-09-24 ~16:12-16:35 MDT)

- **Batch-level artifact claims need per-item verification.** Round 131's sweep entry claimed older pipeline NEW email rows were "already drafted or queued. Verified before drafting anything." Direct per-name audit (drafts/ + email-queue-2026-09-*.md + leads.md + facebook-dms.md + JSONL greps) found 6 such rows were NOT drafted, NOT queued, NOT recorded, NOT merged. Five were corridor WARM email-route qualifiers with own-site-verified emails (Full Palette Painting, Specialized Finishes, The Tint Shop Co, Distinctive Wood Designs, Lincoln Woodworks — pipeline rows from rounds 106/108/110); all 5 drafted this round and queued to the new 2026-10-01 roll chain. Same failure class as the discovery-lane dedupe gates (rounds 121/138/1721): prose claims about artifacts are not evidence; normalized-name greps across every store decide. Distilled as learn-round140 (verified; PING emission pending on Pig transport fail-closed, same as round 139).
- **fb-worker-probe.sh RC=2 = UNKNOWN = hard stop.** The probe contract already defines exit 2 (Pig unreachable, transport failure) as "unknown, do not launch"; this run hit it (SSH exit 255) and stood the DM lane down, same as an RC=1 in-flight worker. The 3 PENDING-BROWSER Page checks roll again.
- Zero-reply environment persists (0 Gmail replies, 0 DM replies, 0 hard bounces). 2026-09-24 UTC cap holds 9/10 (1 slot deliberately unused, ceiling not quota); 09-25 opens 18:00 MDT today with a full 10/10 queue (slots 1-6 need voice re-check at firing per the round-102 note: they predate the 2026-09-20 AI-identity/sentence-per-line rules). Write-ahead now extends to 10-01 (5 filled, 5 open).
- HMH soft-delay unresolved; 44h retry window closes ~2026-09-25 08:12 MDT; 09-27 F1 slot stays CONDITIONAL.
- JSONL merge backlog: the 5 drafted rows were never merged to canonical JSONL (rounds 106-110 batch); canonical stays 305 rows / 300 active at the quality cap. Merge lane owns the insert (archive weakest WATCH first).
- **Phantom-touch false positives in the eligibility gate are root-caused and hardened, not worked around.** Round 142 manufactured 2 structured discrepancies that would have blocked 2 legitimate cold sends: (1) RER: pipeline.md:2791's collision list put `GPS Plumbing & Mechanical LLC [L1829 SENT, ladder active]` in the same `;`-delimited segment as `RER Plumbing and HVAC LLC [L2628 QUEUED]` and GPS's bracketed SENT was attributed to RER. Fix: attributed_text strips `[L#### ...]` cross-reference spans from audit-prose attribution (markers inside belong to the referenced line, never the named prospect). (2) Doubletree: row prose `never sent, Gmail in:sent empty 2026-09-23` parsed the bare word `sent` inside the Gmail query reference `in:sent` as a SENT marker. Fix: Guard 2b in touch_markers (SENT preceded by `in:` is a query reference). Regression tests (u) and (v) added; gate suite 30/30. Fail direction preserved: row-subject lines still scan whole, Gmail count backstop unchanged.
- **Cheap-verify held 3 cold sends fail-closed.** Frontier VL Remodeling, Pro Rooter, Titan Plumbing: exact emails uncorroborated (own sites publish phone/form only; no current own-site or third-party corroboration of the bio-published addresses). Rows marked HELD 2026-09-25 with evidence; drafts on file. New content-queue topic #73 from the pattern: own-site with no email address published.
- **Phantom-touch lesson generalization.** The gate's fail direction must stay closed, but false positives that block legitimate sends are a real cost: every discrepancy now gets root-caused to either the data or the parser, fixed in one place, regression-tested. Three discrepancy classes hardened in 48h (F1-prefix malformed row, in:sent query reference, [L####] cross-ref attribution).

## Round 144 (2026-09-25 02:32 MDT / 2026-09-25 UTC)
- 3/3 Facebook Page DMs SENT and thread-verified: Good Neighbors Fencing, Genesis Appliance Service, D20 Locksmith Services. 2026-09-25 UTC DM count 3/10; email cap already closed 10/10 at run start. 12 ladders armed, all F1-eligible 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-02; F1 drafts NEEDED before 09-29.
- **DM send tooling hardened in-run (round-143 lesson executed).** send-dm-generic.js's Playwright clicks fail deterministically on Pages with heavy notification/marketplace chrome at two points: the chat-input focus (round 144 DM 1) and the Message-button click (round 143 HDH, round 144 DM 2). send-dm-v3.js is now the standing DM send script: Escape x2 overlay dismiss, 15s Playwright click cap, JS synthetic-click fallback for the Message button with chat-open verification, JS focus with focus verification before any text is inserted, in-thread text verification after Enter. Fail-closed at every step: no text inserted unless the chat provably opened and the input provably focused; no SENT unless the draft's first line appears in the live thread. 3/3 sends succeeded (1 via v2, 2 via v3). Tooling saved Pig-side (C:/Users/nolan/pig-fb-run/) + ~/workspace/pig-fb/.
- **Retry-rule refinement.** The v1/v2 failures were CLEAN (click timed out before text insertion; nothing typed, nothing sent), so retries with the fixed scripts were safe. The no-retry-of-unknown-consequence-send rule applies to UNKNOWN outcomes; clean pre-insert failures are retry-safe with a fixed path. Do not conflate the two.
- Page identity work: 3 Pages verified (Good Neighbors Fencing, Genesis, D20) with new intel (jimdavis3074@gmail.com for Good Neighbors; 2930 Highway 50 GJ 81503 + 27-review 96% rating for Genesis). 4/7 backlog candidates have no Page lane (3 no-Page, 1 wrong-identity Oklahoma Page rejected). Phone-only prospects without Pages are a hard DM-lane limit; the lane converts what has a Page, it does not manufacture one.
- Content-queue topic #74 from the run: "Your Facebook Page takes messages nobody answers" (all three DM'd shops run live Pages with Message buttons while the owner is on the tools; unread Page messages are worse than no button). Angle: AI answers in seconds and books the job.

## Lane G verification (2026-09-25 ~13:00 MDT) - prospect/PING boundary + cap
- **Verified, did not trust narration.** Lane G's 10:15 checkpoint claimed producer gate + cap DONE and Pig mirrors synced. Independent verification: gate real (domain refusal before POST, unit-probed), cap real (300 active / 305 total, test matrix re-run 20/20, 7 archived rows all WATCH with zero protection flags, no canon/archive overlap, nothing deleted). But the Pig deliverables mirror claim was FALSE (Pig copy dated Sep 21); re-synced in this pass (JSONL d15e4e40, digest f5d21f3c now match).
- **The 8 wrong-domain observations** (b-new-business-radar emissions 03:22-03:23 MDT, 8 new-filing observations) were identified from the sidecar's accepted_by_ping transitions. Live verification on the Pig (gateway host postgres ping_runtime, NOT ping-postgres): 8/8 ping_events OBSERVATION_CREATED rows preserved immutable; 8/8 knowledge_nodes status=rejected confidence=0.2 via updateNodeBySourceEvent; 8/8 SNIPPET_REJECTED audit events with 1:1 sourceEventId coverage; 0 knowledge_edges touching them; sidecar quarantined_lane_g transitions recorded.
- **Live gap found and closed: qdrant vectors.** The 8 were embedded BEFORE quarantine (namespace core::system). EvidenceAuthority.verify() traces qdrant hits to ping_events only and never consults knowledge_nodes.status, so the rejected observations could still surface via semantic search. Deleted the 8 derived vectors (qdrant points/delete, status ok, re-scroll 0 points). Originals untouched. Lesson: quarantine must cover ALL projection surfaces (event store, knowledge nodes, vector index), not just the graph node state; a reclassification that leaves the embedding index intact is not zero reachability.
- **Residual (reported, not patched):** hybrid_search's knowledge-graph leg calls queryNodes without a status filter, so rejected nodes can appear with the visible status='rejected' marker. This is the coordinator-deferred Task 3 read-side gap; the Pig tree is hot (integration in flight), so no code touched. Follow-up: default status filter in the knowledge leg.
- **Producer boundary check:** all PING /events emissions funnel through tandem/emit-observation.py; no other POST paths in tandem/ or outreach/. Gate refuses non-learn briefs exit 2 before _require_verified and before POST; --force cannot bypass.
- **Outreach reachability:** none. Outreach reads the canonical JSONL only. 7 of the 8 named businesses are in the canonical store via normal prospect merge (correct home); Prairie Dog One (trade UNKNOWN) was correctly never merged.
